title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between observed and predicted values. A residual plot helps us understand how well a model fits the data.

title: Analyzing the Residual Plot
text: Look at the pattern of the residuals. If they show a clear pattern, it might indicate a problem with the model.

title: Pattern in Residuals
text: The residuals seem to increase as $$x$$ increases. This suggests that the model is consistently underpredicting as $$x$$ increases.

title: Conclusion from Residual Plot
text: Based on the residual plot, what can you conclude about the model's predictions?
choices: As $$x$$ increases, the model performs worse.
A linear model works well for this data.
